description: Delete one workflow secret from a repository by name (cron_secret is read as CRON_SECRET). Idempotent: deleting a secret that is already gone succeeds with deleted:false, already_deleted:true, so a retry is safe. Workflows that reference it stop receiving it. Needs admin access to the repository and 'repo' scope. Audit-logged (name only). Returns {repository, name, deleted, already_deleted, at}.

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_delete_repo_secret
